fact: Linux 6.x kernels require raw eBPF program types to specify GPL compatible licenses

Huawei / Vodafone USB modems (e.g. K4203) enumerate initially as USB Mass Storage (vendor 12d1:1f1c) and require an explicit SCSI eject sequence (55534243123456780000000000000011062000000101000100000000000000) sent via usb_modeswitch to flip into high-speed CDC/serial modem interfaces (12d1:157a).

Running headless browser automation (Puppeteer/Playwright) on ARM Android/Termux fails due to missing glibc/Chromium binaries; headless automation on Android must use raw WebSocket protocol clients (e.g., Baileys) and pure Node.js sockets instead of browser engines.

WhatsApp voice note compatibility requires Opus audio inside an OGG container with a strict sample rate of 48,000 Hz and mono audio channel; sending raw AAC or standard MP3 causes voice notes to render as generic audio files without waveform scrubbing.

Dalvik VMP register scrambling using a coprime affine permutation ((r * A + B) % N with gcd(A, N) = 1 seeded by SHA-256) completely destroys linear register flow for decompilers (JEB/Jadx) without register collisions or out-of-bounds wide operations in native execution.

In embedded and native security loaders, raw C string literals for /proc/, /dev/, or binary magics (dex\n035) are trivially extracted by automated static scanners; strings must be XOR-encoded at compile time and stack buffers immediately wiped using volatile pointer dereferencing (secure_bzero) to prevent compiler dead-code elimination.

Samsung File-Based Encryption (FBE) & Knox On-Device Encryption (ODE) Disabling: Attaining unencrypted storage in custom recoveries (TWRP/OrangeFox) requires four synchronized steps: (1) Neutralizing AVB 2.0 / dm-verity via patched vbmeta (flags 0x3) and patched boot/recovery; (2) Disarming vendor fstab forced encryption by replacing fileencryption= and forceencrypt= with encryptable in /vendor/etc/fstab.{qcom,exynos,mt*} and neutralizing recovery-from-boot.p; (3) Executing TWRP 'Format Data' (make_ext4fs/mkfs.f2fs) to destroy ciphertext and recreate an unencrypted filesystem; (4) Wiping Knox ODE partitions (/keydata, /keyrefuge) to eliminate orphan cryptographic tokens that cause reboot loops.

Samsung Galaxy One UI Core devices on Android 11+ dynamically register IME input methods and home launcher activities. Disabling com.sec.android.app.launcher or com.samsung.android.honeyboard leaves the window manager without a fallback intent receiver, causing SystemUI to drop into a black screen without crash logs.

On MediaTek Helio G85 (MT6769V) eMMC 5.1 devices, Samsung's SSG block I/O scheduler delivers optimal UI latency when tuned for read expiration (read_expire=100ms, write_expire=10000ms, front_merges=0). For SurfaceFlinger UI thread boosting, FIFO realtime scheduling (chrt -f 75) introduces complete system starvation risk; standard nice level elevation (renice -10) paired with realtime I/O class (ionice -c 1) provides frame rate stability without freeze hazards.

In Ubuntu 24.04 and GNOME/GTK4 Python applications lacking python3-gi-cairo, DrawingArea callbacks fail with foreign struct converter errors for cairo.Context. The clean cross-distro solution is rendering to pycairo ImageSurface, wrapping with GLib.Bytes -> Gdk.MemoryTexture, and setting on Gtk.Picture. In addition, AyatanaAppIndicator3 (GTK3) and GTK4 cannot coexist in one Python process; isolating the tray to a child subprocess communicating over non-blocking stdin/stdout JSON pipe provides rock-solid stability.

In X11 window management (GNOME Shell/Mutter/Xorg), making an overlay window click-through (mouse penetration) requires setting ShapeInput (kind=2) via libXfixes XFixesSetWindowShapeRegion to an empty region created with XFixesCreateRegion(display, NULL, 0). To restore normal mouse interaction, pass region=0. Furthermore, for already-mapped windows, setting _NET_WM_STATE via xprop is ignored by Mutter; EWMH strictly requires sending an XClientMessage event to the X11 root window with SubstructureRedirectMask, message_type=_NET_WM_STATE, action=1 (_NET_WM_STATE_ADD), and atom=_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE combined with _NET_WM_STATE_STICKY to persist across all virtual workspaces.

In PyQt6 / Qt on Linux X11 and Wayland desktops, overriding only dragEnterEvent is insufficient for reliable file manager drag-and-drop ingestion. dragMoveEvent must also be explicitly overridden and accepted (ev.acceptProposedAction()), and dropEvent must call ev.acceptProposedAction() for desktop environments (GNOME Nautilus, KDE Dolphin) to recognize the target as a valid drop recipient and deliver the payload.

In Linux 'ss' (iproute2) output, UDP sockets omit the 'State' column by default, shifting Local and Peer address columns to indices 2 and 3 (instead of 3 and 4 as in TCP). Additionally, socket process metadata ('users:(...)') must be explicitly isolated before token splitting, and peer endpoints with wildcard ports ('*:*') must be parsed with fallback handling to prevent int conversion exceptions.

When embedding MPV via subprocess and X11/Wayland window ID (--wid) in custom GUI players (PyQt/GTK), MPV will by default scan and execute external user Lua/JS scripts from ~/.config/mpv/scripts/ (such as uosc or autoload) and load user keybindings, causing duplicate on-screen controllers and input collisions. The embedded instance must pass --no-config, --load-scripts=no, --input-default-bindings=no, and --input-vo-keyboard=no to achieve clean isolation.

In GTK4/Libadwaita, never place navigation headers inside a Gtk.Stack page when handling empty states (Adw.StatusPage). Switching pages completely unmaps the controls, trapping the user. Always keep navigation and actions pinned in a permanent outer container above the stack.

In Qt6 MPV-based video players (libmpv), sending pause=false or toggle_pause when no file is loaded can cause erratic playback state transitions. An idle play handler should guard the engine and resolve the last played track from persistent config, saved playlist active state, or recent file history, loading it with its saved resume timestamp.

When embedding MPV into a Qt widget (via --wid), MPV's default --cursor-autohide (1000ms) directly hides the native X11 window cursor without Qt's knowledge, and pointer events are intercepted by MPV. Passing --cursor-autohide=no, --input-cursor=no, and --input-cursor-passthrough=yes allows pointer events to pass through to Qt widgets and delegates cursor visibility and autohiding entirely to the Qt application.

In Libadwaita, never hardcode set_reveal(True) on Adw.ViewSwitcherBar when an Adw.ViewSwitcherTitle is also in Adw.HeaderBar; this creates redundant duplicate top and bottom navigation tabs. Always bind view_switcher_title.bind_property('title-visible', view_switcher_bar, 'reveal', GObject.BindingFlags.SYNC_CREATE) to hide the bottom bar whenever the header tabs fit.

When crafting Linux desktop UI with GTK4/Libadwaita: replace mobile bottom bars with centered HeaderBar Adw.ViewSwitcher (WIDE policy, default_width >= 620px to prevent tab truncation); custom Cairo ImageSurface canvases must explicitly poll Adw.StyleManager.get_default().get_dark() to dynamically toggle background gradients and grid contrast for both light and dark Adwaita modes; and attach Gtk.ShortcutController for standard <Ctrl>1-5, <Ctrl>R, and <Ctrl>? shortcuts modal.

In GTK4 / Libadwaita, Gtk.Picture displaying a Gdk.MemoryTexture (e.g. from a Cairo ImageSurface) defaults to can_shrink=False. This enforces an intrinsic minimum width equal to the pixel buffer width (e.g. 520px), preventing the parent container or window from shrinking below that dimension and causing layout blowout. Always explicitly call picture.set_can_shrink(True) and picture.set_content_fit(Gtk.ContentFit.FILL).

In GTK4, a Gtk.Label with hexpand=True will NOT yield or shrink below its full text natural width in horizontal box or grid allocations unless label.set_ellipsize(Pango.EllipsizeMode.END) is explicitly set. Dynamic process names, URLs, or paths without ellipsize force sibling widgets off-screen.

In human-centered system monitoring interfaces, raw hardware/kernel device descriptors (e.g., 'enx1ad79c250a5f', 'wlp2s0', sysfs power nodes) must never be displayed as primary hero UI metrics. They must be translated to clear human mental models ('Wired Ethernet', 'Wi-Fi Network', 'Secure VPN') with raw technical identifiers relegated to secondary captions or tooltips.

Android VideoView with MediaPlayer throws error (1, -1004) when playing un-muxed DASH WebM/MP4 streams. Returning true from setOnErrorListener suppresses the intrusive system error dialog, allowing a graceful Material 3 fallback UI to prompt opening in VLC or external player.

Facebook Lite video streams with VP9 vencode tags are packaged in ISO Base Media / MP4 containers (ftyp: isom/mp41/dash/vp09) rather than Matroska containers. Saving them with .webm causes Stagefright MatroskaExtractor to reject them with an 'unsupported file type' error. They must be saved with .mp4 extension and played using Jetpack Media3 ExoPlayer, which contains native Fmp4/Mp4 extractors supporting the vp09 sample entry.

Jetpack Media3 Transformer requires OpenGL ES shaders (shaders/vertex_shader_transformation_es2.glsl) loaded via context.getAssets().open(). When executed inside a hooked host process via Xposed/LSPosed, context.getAssets() points to the host app APK where Media3 assets do not exist, throwing a FileNotFoundException. To resolve, wrap the application context with a ContextWrapper that overrides getAssets() using createPackageContext(modulePackage, CONTEXT_IGNORE_SECURITY or CONTEXT_INCLUDE_CODE).assets. Additionally, Android 11 MPEG4Extractor.cpp fails on VP9 in MP4 boxes (video/unknown); Media3 Transformer bypasses this with user-space track extractors.

In Qt/X11 video players embedding MPV via wid (window ID), dynamically altering window flags via QWidget.setWindowFlags() destroys and recreates the underlying X11 window surface, crashing MPV with BadWindow. Stay-on-top must instead be toggled dynamically via libX11 sending an EWMH _NET_WM_STATE ClientMessage (_NET_WM_STATE_ADD / _NET_WM_STATE_REMOVE with _NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE) to preserve the native surface.

When embedding a video renderer inside a QWidget configured with WA_OpaquePaintEvent=True without paintEvent, alien child overlay widgets (such as text or volume HUDs) cause pixel ghosting when shrinking or changing text size because Qt backing-store dirty rect clipping leaves unrepainted regions. Decoupling HUD overlays into independent top-level Qt.WindowType.Tool frameless transparent windows (WA_TranslucentBackground) delegates composition to the desktop window manager, completely eliminating ghosting artifacts.

In Linux network telemetry and bandwidth quota meters, socket parsers (such as ss or /proc/net/tcp) must explicitly filter loopback endpoints (127.0.0.0/8, ::1, localhost) to prevent local inter-process communication (LSP servers, ADB, compiler RPCs) from contaminating external internet quota accounting. Furthermore, time-series snapshot tables must atomically delete aggregated records during periodic rollup to guarantee query idempotency across UNION ALL operations.
